problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix? 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 2 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, it is an upper triangular matrix.

It is not a lower triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element above the diagonal: ${a}_{12}=4\ne 0.$
